verdict.line: You lose extended Q poke exchanges before level 6, but win from mid-game once your sustain items come online.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) is a 3.5s-cooldown poke tool that out-trades Volibear's slower 12s Q (Thundering Smash) in the first few levels, which is why he holds the lane and solo-kill edge early. Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) double-cast heal and later sustain items flip that math over a long lane, matching the 51.9% head-to-head win rate over 129 games — better than Volibear's 48.4% average.

theirWindow.what: His next hit fires a shockwave that pulls you in, setting up a follow-up with W (Path Maker). Back off before the second stack lands or be ready to eat the pull without a free stun on you.

yourWindow.when: his W (Path Maker) and E (Footwork) are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no stun, no knockback, and no dash-shield to disengage. Walk up and chain Q (Thundering Smash) into double W (Frenzied Maul) for the mark bonus damage and heal.

powerCurve.note: his 3.5s Q poke outpaces your 12s Q
Path Maker stun threatens every all-in
W double-cast heal closes the gap
sustain items outlast his All Out risk

start.why: Measured at 51.6% win rate; the extra damage and sustain let you win W (Frenzied Maul) trades against his Q poke instead of just surviving them.

boots.why: Measured at 58.1% win rate; the tenacity directly cuts the duration of Path Maker's stun and All Out's knockback, his two hard CC sources.

core.why: First item in the highest-winrate recorded path (60% over 5 games); gives the early tempo to punish cooldowns.
Grievous Wounds and omnivamp directly counter his All Out self-healing and your own sustain-trade plan.
Stacks healing amplification on top of W's recast heal, turning every extended trade in your favor.

situational.when: you are ahead and snowballing, since lower cooldowns on Q and W let you chain the stun-heal combo more often
the lane turns into a long poke war, since extra sustain and a slow answer his Q chip damage
their team shifts into a mixed physical/magic damage comp, since the adaptive resistances cover both

runes.keystoneWhy: Measured at 75% win rate on this page; the per-trade healing and max health growth directly answer his low-cooldown Q poke, which is the stat behind his early lane advantage.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the standard pick at 65.6% of games and a solid 52.5% win rate; the burn punishes the all-in windows you open once his Path Maker and Footwork are both down.

playing.title: Bait the Q poke
playing.detail: Don't stand still inside his 450-range Ntofo Strikes line for free pokes. Make him walk up to land it, then punish the approach with W (Frenzied Maul).

playing.title: Track his Ntofo stacks
playing.detail: At 2 stacks his next hit fires a pulling shockwave. Disengage before the second stack lands or be ready to tank the pull without extra CC on you.

playing.title: Trade right after Path Maker
playing.detail: His W is his only stun and it's on a 14-10s cooldown. Once it's used, step in with Q (Thundering Smash) into a double W for the mark damage and heal.

playing.title: Don't fight the charge-up
playing.detail: Path Maker's channel reduces his damage taken before the dash. Wait out the charge instead of trading into it, then punish the recovery.

playing.title: Zone with Sky Splitter
playing.detail: E's 1200 range lets you slow and shield off his Footwork repositioning rather than just using it for poke damage.

playing.title: Double-tap W in every trade
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul's second cast on the same marked target heals you. Always recast it in extended exchanges to offset his Q chip damage.

playing.title: Use R to shut down his All Out dive
playing.detail: Stormbringer disables nearby enemy towers on landing. Save it to punish his All Out all-in under your tower rather than using it as a standalone engage.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reading of cooldowns, stacks, and trade windows is our own analysis of the ability text.
